title: Observed braking in 2025 qualifying
caption: Native OpenF1 qualifying car observations for Red Bull Racing drivers 1 and 22. Each point represents one eligible lap. Horizontal lines mark driver medians. Summed entry-minus-exit speed loss and median onset-to-onset distance use complete bouts only. Spacing excludes transitions across gaps and the timing line. Binary brake observations describe braking opportunity. Electrical delivery and battery recovery are unobserved.
